name: 15e sequence packing
title: Packing fills every slot of the window that padding wastes
subtitle: Window of n = 8 tokens; four documents of 4, 2, 3 and 3 tokens, each followed by one end-of-document token

steps.caption: Four documents of different lengths. Each one ends with an end-of-document token, so they hold 5, 3, 4 and 4 tokens, 16 in total, and the training window holds n = 8 tokens.

Padding gives each document its own window and fills the rest with a pad token that the loss ignores. Four windows hold 32 slots, 16 of them padding, so half of the compute spent on this batch is wasted.

Packing concatenates the documents into one stream and cuts it every 8 tokens. The same 16 tokens fit in two full windows, and the end-of-document token marks where one document stops and the next begins.
Window 1 holds documents A and B. A causal mask alone lets each token read every earlier token, 8 × 9 / 2 = 36 pairs, and 15 of them let B1, B2 and its end token read document A, an unrelated text.

A document mask removes those 15 pairs, leaving 15 inside A plus 6 inside B. Without it the model learns from false context. At real scale, with documents averaging 600 tokens, padding to n = 4,096 would waste about 85 percent of every window.
